headline: Performance Marketing | Acquisition Testing | Campaign Analytics
headline_rationale: CareerSwift needs hands-on campaign execution, audience/creative tests, ROI reporting and collaboration for an AI-powered product. Emphasize supported paid-media experimentation, analytics and technical automation.
summary: Performance marketer combining hands-on campaign execution with disciplined acquisition testing and reporting. Managed Google, Microsoft and paid social channels, tested audiences and conversion paths, and improved ROAS from 1.5 to 3.5 while scaling monthly marketing volume fourfold. Configured GA4 and Google Tag Manager measurement and built dashboards for campaign decisions. Works across creative, content and web teams, with Python, SQL and AI-assisted technical experience that supports faster analysis and practical marketing automation.
factual_review: Read exact CareerSwift Performance Marketing Specialist job. Facts supported by E030/E037/E043/E038/E006/E009/E044/E021 and current AI projects. No claim of specific CareerSwift product experience or unsupported acquisition outcomes.
tools_rationale: Supported acquisition, measurement and automation tools relevant to CareerSwift's campaign execution role.
